move.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We understand that your capacity is fully committed and that a firm volume commitment matters; the binding volume below represents our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you. We value the opportunity to build a long-term relationship with you—could you improve your offer on this basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 4200 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).
Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 30.51 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, for our full demand of 4200 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Thanks for the volume commitment, that really helps us plan things out here. Yeah, delivery was a bit bumpy last quarter, but we're on it. 

With the material drops, we can do your 14 days payment and 42 days lead time, but we need €31.00 per piece. So our Angebot is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. 

Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
